entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Khanpasha Nuradilovich Nuradilov was a Soviet machine gunner in the Red Army between 1940 and 1942. He is credited with killing an estimated 920 enemy soldiers. Additionally, he also credited with captured 18 soldiers and 7 machine guns. He disappeared in battle of Stalingrad (1942).
